title: Cold Drink Ka Dhamaal!
style: 3D animated movie still in the style of a Pixar film, a glossy cute character with big expressive eyes and a small headband, hyper-detailed macro close-up, cinematic soft lighting, rich colours, vertical 9:16

THANDA BHAI.look: A sparkling, brightly colored, anthropomorphic cold drink bottle with a cool smirk and sunglasses, a slight bulge from all the sugar inside.

CHINI DADI.look: A small, white, crystallized pile of sugar wearing a tiny, old-fashioned saree and spectacles, looking a bit mischievous but also concerned.

PAANI DOST.look: A clear, cheerful water droplet with big friendly eyes and a small leaf hat, looking calm and helpful, gently offering a glass.

scenes.image: [[A sparkling, brightly colored, anthropomorphic cold drink bottle with a cool smirk and sunglasses, posing confidently.]]
scenes.speaker: THANDA BHAI
scenes.line: Arre bhai log, aa gaya tumhara manpasand thanda!
scenes.say: अरे भाई लोग, आ गया तुम्हारा मनपसंद ठंडा!

scenes.image: [[A sparkling, brightly colored, anthropomorphic cold drink bottle with a cool smirk and sunglasses, posing confidently.]]
scenes.speaker: THANDA BHAI
scenes.line: Main hoon tumhara jhakkaas thanda, mehfil ki shaan!
scenes.say: मैं हूँ तुम्हारा झक्कास ठंडा, महफ़िल की शान!

scenes.image: [[A sparkling, brightly colored, anthropomorphic cold drink bottle with a cool smirk and sunglasses, posing confidently.]]
scenes.speaker: THANDA BHAI
scenes.line: Par mere mein bahut sara sugar hai, sehat ke liye lafda hai.
scenes.say: पर मेरे में बहुत सारा शुगर है, सेहत के लिए लाफड़ा है.

scenes.image: [[A small, white, crystallized pile of sugar wearing a tiny, old-fashioned saree and spectacles, looking a bit mischievous but also concerned.]]
scenes.speaker: CHINI DADI
scenes.line: Main hoon Chini, is thande ki asli rani, meetha mera kaam.
scenes.say: मैं हूँ चीनी, इस ठंडे की असली रानी, मीठा मेरा काम.

scenes.image: [[A small, white, crystallized pile of sugar wearing a tiny, old-fashioned saree and spectacles, looking a bit mischievous but also concerned.]]
scenes.speaker: CHINI DADI
scenes.line: Mere ek dabbe mein toh main kayi chammach bhar ke baithi hoon, samjhe?
scenes.say: मेरे एक डब्बे में तो मैं कई चम्मच भर के बैठी हूँ, समझे?

scenes.image: [[A small, white, crystallized pile of sugar wearing a tiny, old-fashioned saree and spectacles, looking a bit mischievous but also concerned.]]
scenes.speaker: CHINI DADI
scenes.line: Zyada khaoge toh BP aur sugar badh sakti hai, dhyan dena.
scenes.say: ज़्यादा खाओगे तो बीपी और शुगर बढ़ सकती है, ध्यान देना.

scenes.image: [[A sparkling, brightly colored, anthropomorphic cold drink bottle with a cool smirk and sunglasses, looking a bit sheepish now.]]
scenes.speaker: THANDA BHAI
scenes.line: Sahi pakde hain Dadi, main toh swaad deta hoon, par khatra bhi.
scenes.say: सही पकड़े हैं दादी, मैं तो स्वाद देता हूँ, पर खतरा भी.

scenes.image: [[A sparkling, brightly colored, anthropomorphic cold drink bottle with a cool smirk and sunglasses, looking a bit sheepish now.]]
scenes.speaker: THANDA BHAI
scenes.line: Mera ek pyaala matlab kayi chammach chini seedhi andar.
scenes.say: मेरा एक प्याला मतलब कई चम्मच चीनी सीधी अंदर.

scenes.image: [[A sparkling, brightly colored, anthropomorphic cold drink bottle with a cool smirk and sunglasses, looking a bit sheepish now.]]
scenes.speaker: THANDA BHAI
scenes.line: Har din mujhe piyoge toh shareer ko tanav milega, bhai.
scenes.say: हर दिन मुझे पियोगे तो शरीर को तनाव मिलेगा, भाई.

scenes.image: [[A clear, cheerful water droplet with big friendly eyes and a small leaf hat, looking calm and helpful, gently offering a glass.]]
scenes.speaker: PAANI DOST
scenes.line: Arre bhai log, main hoon tumhara saccha dost, Paani.
scenes.say: अरे भाई लोग, मैं हूँ तुम्हारा सच्चा दोस्त, पानी.

scenes.image: [[A clear, cheerful water droplet with big friendly eyes and a small leaf hat, looking calm and helpful, gently offering a glass.]]
scenes.speaker: PAANI DOST
scenes.line: Main tumhe tarotaaza rakhta hoon, bina kisi chini ke lafde ke.
scenes.say: मैं तुम्हें तरोताज़ा रखता हूँ, बिना किसी चीनी के लफड़े के.

scenes.image: [[A clear, cheerful water droplet with big friendly eyes and a small leaf hat, looking calm and helpful, gently offering a glass.]]
scenes.speaker: PAANI DOST
scenes.line: Nimbu paani ya chaas piyo, woh ek number hain, ek dum swasth.
scenes.say: नींबू पानी या छास पियो, वो एक नंबर हैं, एक दम स्वस्थ.

scenes.image: [[A sparkling, brightly colored, anthropomorphic cold drink bottle, now looking a bit thoughtful, perhaps holding a water bottle.]]
scenes.speaker: THANDA BHAI
scenes.line: Haan yaar, Paani Dost sahi bol raha hai, main kabhi-kabar hi accha.
scenes.say: हाँ यार, PAANI DOST सही बोल रहा है, मैं कभी-कभार ही अच्छा.

scenes.image: [[A sparkling, brightly colored, anthropomorphic cold drink bottle, now looking a bit thoughtful, perhaps holding a water bottle.]]
scenes.speaker: THANDA BHAI
scenes.line: Agar koyi sehat ka masla hai, toh seedha doctor ke paas jaane ka.
scenes.say: अगर कोई सेहत का मसला है, तो सीधा डॉक्टर के पास जाने का.

scenes.image: [[A sparkling, brightly colored, anthropomorphic cold drink bottle, now looking a bit thoughtful, perhaps holding a water bottle.]]
scenes.speaker: THANDA BHAI
scenes.line: Thoda bahut peene mein dikkat nahi, par roz-roz theek nahi.
scenes.say: थोड़ा बहुत पीने में दिक़्क़त नहीं, पर रोज़-रोज़ ठीक नहीं.

scenes.image: [[A small, white, crystallized pile of sugar wearing a tiny, old-fashioned saree and spectacles, smiling kindly and nodding.]]
scenes.speaker: CHINI DADI
scenes.line: Ekdum sahi! Apni sehat ki chaabi tumhare haath mein hai, bacche.
scenes.say: एकदम सही! अपनी सेहत की चाबी तुम्हारे हाथ में है, बच्चे.

scenes.image: [[A small, white, crystallized pile of sugar wearing a tiny, old-fashioned saree and spectacles, smiling kindly and nodding.]]
scenes.speaker: CHINI DADI
scenes.line: Is thande ko khaas mauko par hi peene ka.
scenes.say: इस ठंडे को ख़ास मौक़ों पर ही पीने का.

scenes.image: [[A small, white, crystallized pile of sugar wearing a tiny, old-fashioned saree and spectacles, smiling kindly and nodding.]]
scenes.speaker: CHINI DADI
scenes.line: Tum batao, tumhara manpasand swasth pey kaun sa hai?
scenes.say: तुम बताओ, तुम्हारा मनपसंद स्वस्थ पेय कौन सा है?
